samples.summary: Neutering `setLocalSelection` silently removes a working collaboration feature for viewer mounts: peers no longer see a viewer's caret
samples.evidence: `readOnlyNoteStore` routes `setLocalSelection` to the shared `noop` (packages/notes/src/store/read-only.ts, the final `else` branch), and `initialize()` now hands that guarded handle to every plugin via `noteStoreFacet.of(store)` (packages/notes/src/view/editor.ts:485). The out-of-diff consumer is `NoteRemoteSelectionsPluginValue.update` at packages/notes/src/view/remote-selection.ts:170/172, which publishes the local caret on every ViewUpdate. Before this delta a viewer-role share-link visitor's caret/selection was published to presence (`YorkieNoteStore.setLocalSelection`, packages/frontend/src/app/notes/yorkie-note-store.ts:415) and rendered on every editor's screen by that same plugin's `buildDecorations` (line 181). It is now silently dropped, so an editor collaborating with a viewer loses the "someone is reading here" caret. The viewer's own screen is unaffected (peer carets still render, `getPeerSelections`/`subscribePresence` are allowlisted readers), and the change looks deliberate (the wrapper's comment says as much), but the behaviour change lands in a module the diff does not touch and no test or design doc records it. Fix belongs either on the new allowlist (treat presence publish as a read-ish member) or as an explicit note in docs/design/notes/notes.md.

samples.summary: The new store-level guard is pinned to the `readOnly` value present at first mount — the mount effect's dependency list excludes `readOnly`
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-view.tsx:167-174 returns/re-runs only on `[didMount, doc]` (with `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` disabled), yet the effect body now makes two authorization decisions from `readOnly`: `if (!readOnly) ensureText(doc)` (line 139, a real `doc.update` write, with the raw writable `doc` still in scope) and `const store = readOnly ? readOnlyNoteStore(raw) : raw` (line 152). If a mount's `readOnly` ever flips without `doc` changing identity, the editor keeps the handle chosen for the old value — an unguarded raw store on a mount that has since become viewer-only. Today the only prop source is `SharedNotesLayout` (`packages/frontend/src/app/shared/shared-notes-layout.tsx:44`, `resolved.role === "viewer"`), which appears fixed for the life of the mount, so I could not confirm reachability; confirming it would need to show `resolved.role` can change while the Yorkie `doc` object identity does not. The fix belongs on the new code: add `readOnly` to the dependency list (or assert it is immutable per mount).
